LESSON: ENERGY RESOURCES

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Environment and its
Topic 1.7: Energy resources

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Energy resources. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify ways of producing sounds from different objects
2. create sounds from a variety of sources for enjoyment
3. develop curiosity in producing sounds from different objects. from common instruments using multimedia resources. 69

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify ways of producing sounds from different objects
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify ways of producing sounds from different objects. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. create sounds from a variety of sources for enjoyment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to create sounds from a variety of sources for enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. develop curiosity in producing sounds from different objects. from common instruments using multimedia resources. 69

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.
